problem: The research program needed versioned field observations and a complete, replayable coverage vector that preserves unknown, failed, blocked, unavailable, stale, and isolated states while keeping access evidence separate from catalog membership.
resulting_behavior: PR-004 emits validated versioned field observations, deterministic as-of access summaries, exact frozen-cohort membership projections, and a hash-bound content-addressed offline compact completeness artifact. Full and compact vectors retain access facts and core contracts; a bound evidence catalog carries record/source/revision bindings and source locators. Offline consumers require independently supplied digest, membership, cohort, generation, and as-of context. Publisher-native identifiers remain distinct from stable USHSO record identifiers. Flat and nested observation-ledger representations of the same revision are compared without their ancestry container, merged by record/source/field/revision identity, and conflicting content is rejected. The compact artifact is stored as a deterministic Node zlib gzip plus inspectable manifest; the loader rejects contradictory manifest metadata, identities, paths and encodings against the actual gzip transport and decoded view, including the historical Git snapshot and every logical count/source/generation field. C-004-1 through C-004-7 were implemented by Luna Max; current packaging ownership is Grok.
